## Motivation

`SGLANG_CACHE_DIR` is the knob that moves SGLang's on-disk caches: `SGLANG_DG_CACHE_DIR`, `SGLANG_CUTE_AOT_CACHE_DIR` and the third-party caches set by `redirect_third_party_caches()` all derive from it. The JIT kernel build cache does not. `cache_root()` and `_sailify_root()` fall back to a hardcoded `~/.cache/sglang/jit`, so `SGLANG_JIT_CACHE_DIR` has to be set separately.

We ran into this serving DeepSeek V4 Flash on short-lived GPU containers, with `SGLANG_CACHE_DIR` on a persistent volume so cold starts reuse compiled kernels and autotune results. Everything under `SGLANG_CACHE_DIR` was reused, but the `load_jit` kernels on the DSV4 attention path were rebuilt with nvcc on every boot until we also set `SGLANG_JIT_CACHE_DIR` by hand.

## Modifications

- `SGLANG_JIT_CACHE_DIR` now defaults lazily to `$SGLANG_CACHE_DIR/jit` through `_default_cache_subdir("jit")`, the same pattern as `SGLANG_DG_CACHE_DIR` and `SGLANG_CUTE_AOT_CACHE_DIR`. With `SGLANG_CACHE_DIR` unset the path is unchanged (`~/.cache/sglang/jit`), and an explicit `SGLANG_JIT_CACHE_DIR` still wins.
- `cache_root()` and `_sailify_root()` read the env value directly instead of each carrying its own fallback.
- The diffusion quantization doc now gives the default as `$SGLANG_CACHE_DIR/jit`.

One edge case changes: `SGLANG_JIT_CACHE_DIR=""` used to fall back to the default and is now used as given, the same way the other cache dir envs treat an empty value. Happy to keep the old fallback if you prefer.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable: no kernel or model code changes.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable: only the cache location changes.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

New `test_cache_root_follows_sglang_cache_dir` in `test/registered/unit/kernels/test_jit_cache.py` fails on main (resolves to `~/.cache/sglang/jit`) and passes with this change.

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

files.patch:
@@ -405,7 +405,7 @@ weights and per-row scales, so the choice is made per layer at load time:
 - `jit`: the `convrot_int8` ops in `sglang.kernels.ops.gemm.convrot_int8`,
   compiled by SGLang's JIT for the local GPU on first use (about a minute with
   `nvcc` on the machine; cached under `SGLANG_JIT_CACHE_DIR`, default
-  `~/.cache/sglang/jit`, for later runs). CC 9.0 (Hopper), 10.0 (B200, GB200)
+  `$SGLANG_CACHE_DIR/jit`, for later runs). CC 9.0 (Hopper), 10.0 (B200, GB200)
   and 12.0 / 12.1 (RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, RTX 50 series, DGX Spark); group
   size 64, 128, 256 or 512; output width a multiple of 8. CC 10.3 (B300,
   GB300) is refused on purpose: Blackwell Ultra cuts INT8 tensor-core

@@ -1323,9 +1323,9 @@ class Envs:
     # Everything here is a developer knob for working ON kernels -- building
     # them, inspecting what the compiler produced, and benchmarking them. Flags
     # that select a kernel in production live with their own feature instead.
-    # JIT kernel build cache. None = unset, resolving to ~/.cache/sglang/jit;
+    # JIT kernel build cache. Resolved lazily so it tracks SGLANG_CACHE_DIR;
     # point it at a persistent mount to share builds across CI jobs.
-    SGLANG_JIT_CACHE_DIR = EnvStr(None)
+    SGLANG_JIT_CACHE_DIR = EnvStr(lambda: _default_cache_subdir("jit"))
     # Log, at INFO, which dependency changed whenever a module is rebuilt.
     SGLANG_JIT_CACHE_DEBUG = EnvBool(False)
     # How many builds to keep per module variant. None = unset = keep all, which

@@ -515,6 +515,15 @@ def test_layout_is_readable_and_scoped_by_build_key():
     assert scope.parent.parent.name == cache._target_tag()
 
 
+def test_cache_root_follows_sglang_cache_dir(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.delenv("SGLANG_JIT_CACHE_DIR", raising=False)
+    monkeypatch.setenv("SGLANG_CACHE_DIR", str(tmp_path))
+    assert cache.cache_root() == tmp_path / "jit"
+
+    monkeypatch.setenv("SGLANG_JIT_CACHE_DIR", str(tmp_path / "elsewhere"))
+    assert cache.cache_root() == tmp_path / "elsewhere"
+
+
 def test_module_name_is_derived_from_the_args():
     assert _spec().module_name == "sgl_kernel_jit_activation_bf16_t"
